notes:
Background: Voice-first vendor building post-call synthesis + QA product for mid-market contact centers.

Customer need: turn every call into a concise, actionable summary (1-2 bullets + coaching flags) and auto-open support tickets when intent=issue. High volume: 6M calls/year target customer base, spike behavior during product incidents.

Security/Compliance: handles PII/PCI in transcripts; must support redaction (masking + automated PCI removal), SSO/SAML, audit logs, and option for data residency. Wants SOC2 + ISO roadmap.

Technical constraints: needs sub-10s end-to-end post-call summary after call completes; prefer streaming interim highlights during long calls; target p95 summary generation <1.2s for 80% of calls in dedicated pool. Strong interest in dedicated pools and autoscaling for incident bursts.

Quote from discovery call: "We need summaries our QA coaches actually use — not paragraphs, actionable coaching snippets and a confidence score." — Head of QA.

Recent decision drivers: cost per summary, ability to route to cheaper quantized models for non-sensitive calls, and deterministic fallbacks during GPU pressure.

Decision timeline: wants POC in November, evaluation of latency/quality in Dec, procurement in Jan (if POC meets SLA).
